# Pull Request / 变更提交

English is the default. Chinese notes may follow each section.

默认使用英语，必要时可在每节后补充中文。

## Change / 改动说明

Explain the problem, why this change belongs in the project, and which research
or runtime boundary it affects.

说明问题、改动价值，以及它影响哪一项论文理论或 Runtime 边界。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] I ran `npm test` / 已运行 `npm test`
- [ ] User-facing documentation was updated in English and Simplified Chinese / 用户可见文档已同步英语与简体中文
- [ ] New paper claims use primary sources and follow the review format / 新论文使用一手来源并符合解读规范
- [ ] Runtime changes include success and failure or denial tests / Runtime 改动包含成功与失败或拒绝测试
- [ ] No keys, personal data, paper PDFs, or unauthorized assets are included / 未提交密钥、个人数据、论文 PDF 或无授权素材

## Sources and UI Evidence / 来源与界面证据

List new primary sources. For UI changes, attach desktop and mobile screenshots
for the English default and the Simplified Chinese view.

列出新增一手来源。界面改动请附英语默认页和简体中文页的桌面、移动端截图。
